aboutModal.title: About Regulation Navigator
aboutModal.whyText: EU regulatory compliance is complex and time-consuming. Financial institutions, investment firms, and compliance professionals must navigate dozens of interconnected directives and regulations. Regulation Navigator simplifies this by providing instant answers to your compliance questions using advanced AI and comprehensive regulatory databases.
aboutModal.functionalText:
1. You ask a question about EU regulations
2. The system searches a comprehensive database of regulatory articles
3. AI analyzes the most relevant regulations
4. An answer is generated with direct citations from the source regulations
5. You receive verified information with complete source references
aboutModal.technicalText:
The application uses a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system:
• TF-IDF Vectorization: Converts regulatory text into semantic vectors
• Cosine Similarity: Finds the most relevant articles
• Azure OpenAI (gpt-5-mini): Generates contextual answers
• Token Authentication: Secure access with 2-hour tokens
• REST API: FastAPI backend with core intelligence
• Next.js Frontend: Modern, responsive UI with multi-language support
